hypothesis: A shared 5-minute backbone can predict a cost-aware soft distribution over target signed margin actions, from which direction, sizing, partial reduction, reversal, and full exit-to-flat are derived consistently.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: Prior BTC lines used quality/direction or RL targets that did not jointly model the current position, target exposure, turnover cost, and full-exit-to-flat action contract. This experiment first treats the teacher only as a diagnostic target, not as a promotion result.
research.retest_design: Freeze and preflight the registered BTC feature dataset, analyze every feature before selection, train only on the pre-Validation period, select on Validation only, and score the learned policy solely in a bar-by-bar fresh-forward OOS runner.

groups: all registered causal BTC feature columns, pending statistical feature analysis

selection.validation_pass_criteria: Cost-adjusted Validation PnL is positive, bar-level MDD is within the pre-registered cap, and action entropy and turnover are not degenerate.
